content.value_statement: Microscopy teams need reliable patterns for accessing OMERO data without rebuilding examples from scratch. This skill provides practical Python workflows for images, metadata, ROIs, tables, and batch processing.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to connect to OMERO servers with BlitzGateway and manage sessions.
Explains how to browse projects, datasets, images, screens, plates, and wells.
Provides patterns for reading pixel planes, thumbnails, tiles, and rendering settings.
Covers tags, map annotations, file annotations, comments, and metadata queries.
Demonstrates ROI creation, ROI measurement, OMERO tables, and server-side scripts.
Includes guidance for permissions, group context, filesets, deletion, and cross-group queries.
limitations: Requires access to an OMERO server and valid credentials.
Does not provide a complete application or graphical interface.
Examples must be adapted to local permissions, object IDs, and data policies.
Large image processing still requires memory planning and domain validation.

use_cases.title: Analyze microscopy datasets
use_cases.description: Retrieve image planes, calculate measurements, and store results in OMERO tables.

use_cases.title: Manage research metadata
use_cases.description: Create tags, annotations, and file attachments for images, projects, and datasets.

use_cases.title: Build batch processing scripts
use_cases.description: Create OMERO scripts that process selected datasets and return structured outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Connect to OMERO
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect to an OMERO server with BlitzGateway. Use environment variables for credentials and close the session safely.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve dataset images
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to list images in an OMERO dataset and print each image name, ID, and dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Measure ROI intensities
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow that reads existing ROIs on OMERO images and reports mean intensity per shape and channel.

prompt_templates.title: Design a batch script
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an OMERO server-side script that accepts dataset IDs, processes images, and stores measurements in an OMERO table.

output_examples.input: List projects and datasets for the current OMERO user.
output_examples.output: A clear workflow that connects securely, iterates projects, lists datasets, prints names and IDs, and closes the connection.

output_examples.input: Measure fluorescence values inside existing ROIs.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step analysis plan that retrieves ROI shapes, reads pixel data, calculates intensity statistics, and stores tabular results.

output_examples.input: Attach analysis output files to an image.
output_examples.output: Guidance for creating file annotations, linking them to OMERO objects, and using namespaces for later retrieval.

best_practices: Use secure connections and close sessions with context managers.
Check permissions and group context before reading, writing, or deleting objects.
Validate object IDs, filenames, and output paths before running adapted examples.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode OMERO passwords in scripts or notebooks.
Do not run delete or administrator examples without explicit authorization.
Do not load large image volumes into memory without tiling or batching.

faq.question: What is OMERO?
faq.answer: OMERO is a platform for storing, managing, viewing, and analyzing microscopy images and related metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill require Python?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples focus on the OMERO Python API and the BlitzGateway client.

faq.question: Can it process high-content screening data?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for screens, plates, wells, and well sample images.

faq.question: Can it create or edit ROIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers ROI creation, retrieval, shape parsing, measurements, and deletion patterns.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: It recommends secure connections, environment variables, permission checks, and careful handling of administrator operations.

faq.question: Is it a full OMERO client?
faq.answer: No. It is a reference skill that helps generate and adapt OMERO Python workflows.
